data.one_liner: Create customizable snowfall and falling particle animations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display falling particles such as snow, rain, stars, hearts, and leaves with customizable count, speed, size, color, and frame rate. Supports custom painters and arbitrary widgets as particles.
use_when: You need seasonal background effects like snow or autumn leaves
You want to render lightweight particle effects or rain animations
avoid_when: You need a full-fledged physics or 2D game engine
You are displaying a massive number of complex custom widgets that would choke the UI thread
strengths: Includes several built-in particle shapes and types
Supports custom painters and arbitrary widgets as particles
Configurable frame rate for performance and battery optimization
weaknesses: Heavy use of complex widget-based particles can impact performance

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Lottie if you prefer vector animations designed in After Effects rather than programmatic particle effects.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose flutter_animate for general widget animations, transitions, and effects rather than dedicated particle systems.

alternatives.name: rive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Rive for interactive, state-driven vector animations and game assets.
